entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-01-28
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Microsoft.NET.ApiCompat causes newly added project to fail restore #52718
  • Ability to target `-windows10.0.XXXX.X` TFM for dotnet tools #52716
  • `dotnet run --file` often fails claiming it can't load a non-existent .csproj #52714
  • RPM packages should be built in CI #52712
  • dotnet format: csharp_new_line_before_open_brace without object_collection_array_initializers adds unnecessary space before property patterns inside tuple patterns #52708
  • `dotnet tool install` doesn't support `package@version` syntax #52706
  • Add `/.dotnet` as a supported folder, like `/.config` #52705
  • False positive CA2021 when calling Enumerable.Cast on types that have a primitive type conversion #52704
  • `dotnet workload clean --all` should remove all workload artifacts to help recover from bad states #52701

Closed

  • Autocreate of ~/.aspnet/https is broken #44157
  • `dotnet tool restore` should provide warnings if new versions of tool is available #50991
  • [Microsoft.NET.Sdk.Worker] appsettings are not nested #23364

PullRequests

Created

  • Update runtime dependencies to v10.0.102 #52721
  • Update locBranch to release/10.0.3xx #52720
  • Build RPM packages in CI #52719
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Add `dotnetup --info`, `dotnetup --version`, `dotnetup list` #52717
  • [backport to release/10.0.3xx]Add warnings for newer tool versions during dotnet tool restore #52715
    Area-Tools, cli-ux, 10.0.3xx
  • Support running tests locally in a helix environment on Linux #52713
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0.3xx' => 'main' #52711
  • Embed HotReload in WebAssembly SDK #52710
    Area-WasmSdk
  • Improve error messaging when tool requires unavailable runtime #52709
  • Add tests for package@version and --version conflict validation in tool install/update #52707
  • `workload repair` can recover from corrupt workload sets (#52434) #52700

Merged

  • Unwind changes done during the TFM update #52512
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0.1xx' => 'release/10.0.2xx' #52702
  • [release/10.0.2xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #52703
  • dotnet root command and dotnet watch #52583
  • [release/10.0.2xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #52662
  • [release/10.0.1xx] Fix -extra container variant check to support .NET 9+ #52597
    Servicing-approved, Area-Containers
  • [release/10.0.1xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #52673
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0.1xx' => 'release/10.0.2xx' #52657
  • [release/10.0.1xx] ProcessFrameworkReferences: use portable ILCompiler when RuntimeIdentifier is null. #52485
    Servicing-approved, Area-NetSDK
  • Make it possible to opt out of creating a dylib from the R2R output. #52480
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0.3xx' => 'main' #52519

Updated

  • [WIP] Add layout logic to replace duplicate files with links (Linux/MacOS only) #52044
  • Convert VisualStudioWorkloads to use direct COM #52650
  • [release/10.0.3xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #52585
  • `dotnet run -e FOO=BAR` passes `@(RuntimeEnvironmentVariable)` #52664
  • [dotnet watch] Make application of changes always async #52469
  • Add 'Eliminate Duplicate SDK Files' one-pager #51886
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0.2xx' => 'release/10.0.3xx' #52588
  • Move releases.json cache from %LOCALAPPDATA% root to .dotnet/releases #52698
  • Add TaskHostFactory tests to guard against regression of #12751 in MSBuild #52405
  • Refactor VSHostObject credential extraction for COM compatibility and out-of-process execution #52552
    Area-Containers
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #52596
    Area-CodeFlow
  • Hide NuGet signature verification skip message at baseline verbosity #52684
    Area-Infrastructure
  • [release/10.0.2xx] Fix -extra container variant check to support .NET 9+ #52598
    Servicing-approved, Area-Containers
